title: A sampling design could test a holding-time modulation in neutron storage

statements.text: The joint 2026 paper does not claim to resolve the neutron lifetime anomaly. It models coherent mixing with a sterile sector that would modulate storage lifetimes with holding time, finds current data cannot test the modulation, sets no limit, and gives a sampling design that could.

sources.quote: We do not claim to resolve this anomaly.
We therefore set no limit. Instead, we give a sampling design that could test the modulation.
